timing: Pre-development implementation audit; no metrics or artifacts generated
findings: Independent-head control was initialized from teacher weights, which would leak the target function into the control.
Hash seed metadata was serialized for non-hash controls that do not use maps.
GQA/MQA MAC proxy did not account for their reduced KV projection count.
changes: Independent Q/K/V student weights now use random initialization independent of teacher weights.
Only hashed methods serialize map seeds.
QKV MAC proxy now uses the actual number of Q and KV heads.
